lines: Someone in the audience says what a trick!

then.text: \f[face_namo_girl]\rThe Mysterious Ball is speaking to me again...

else.text: \f[face_namo_boy]\bThe Mysterious Ball is speaking to me again...

list.text: \f[faceButler]\bFor me, the real magic is when I hear your applause.
\f[faceButler]\bI couldn't do the show without Mightyena!
\wmMysterious Ball: I need this Wishing Star, with me...

then.text: \f[faceDiane]\rHey, you have to get back to your seat.
\f[face_namo_girl]\rSorry, but the voice coming from my Mysterious Ball told me to come here.

else.text: \f[faceDiane]\rHey, you have to get back to your seat.
\f[face_namo_boy]\bSorry, but the voice coming from my Mysterious Ball told me to come here.

list.text: \f[faceButler]\bLadies and gentleman, it seems we have a volunteer to help us with our next trick!
\f[faceButler]\bYou must be in show business, because your timing is impecable!
\f[faceButler]\bSince you're obviously a great magician, fist your eyes on Butler's Burning Box!
\f[faceButler]\bYou must simply escape the box before it bursts into flames!

then.text: \f[faceButler]\bA real magician like \v[76] should have no trouble easily escaping from a box like this.
\f[faceButler]\bSo, to make it interesting, she only have 10 seconds untill Dusclops destroys it with his Hyper Beam!

else.text: \f[faceButler]\bA real magician like \v[77] should have no trouble easily escaping from a box like this.
\f[faceButler]\bSo, to make it interesting, he only have 10 seconds untill Dusclops destroys it with his Hyper Beam!

then.text: \f[faceButler]\bNot only she escaped from the box, just in time.
\f[faceButler]\bBut she made bouquet of flowers to appears as well!
\f[faceButler]\bLet's thank this amazing magician \v[76], the Great!

else.text: \f[faceButler]\bNot only he escaped from the box, just in time.
\f[faceButler]\bBut he made bouquet of flowers to appears as well!
\f[faceButler]\bLet's thank this amazing magician \v[77], the Great!

lines: Add some people from the audience saying Bravo!

then.text: \wmThe magic show ended, and \PN and \v[76] went to meet Butler and Diane outside.

else.text: \wmThe magic show ended, and \PN and \v[77] went to meet Butler and Diane outside.
